Russell, cinematic western key-art composition, loose confident brushwork, visible canvas texture. A half-length portrait, the face in the upper third of the picture. The subject is Fanny Faro, an adult woman in her mid-thirties, a handsome frontier card dealer with dark auburn hair pinned up in a loose knot, sharp cheekbones, heavy-lidded grey-green eyes, dark straight eyebrows, a long straight nose and a full, unimpressed mouth. Setting: a cramped one-room plank shack at dusk, gaps between the boards letting in thin blades of sunset, a dented tin lantern, an enamel mug. long low golden dusk light, a strong warm rim light, oil-lamp glow, fine dust hanging in the air. warm sepia palette of saddle brown, dusk amber, sunset red, bone and dust, with gunmetal and violet shadows and a touch of sage green.
